learning_questions: What broke or slowed this release?
What proof was missing until late?
Which gate should become automatic next time?
Which human approval should remain explicit?
proof_commands: verify README, changelog, and release notes match artifact version
purpose: Tell AI agents how this product ships. Store repeatable release config and attempt ledgers. Does not ship, deploy, or run proofs.

related_testr.note: When present, testr test_commands become shipr proof_commands

rollback_paths: bump patch version and release a fixed package; yank only for severe package faults
revert tag and republish previous binary
